purpose: Utility methods for Roblox Color3 values
description: Utility methods for Roblox Color3 values

Color3Utils.luau.description: Utility methods for Roblox Color3 values Public entry points include `Color3Utils.serializeColor3`, `Color3Utils.serializeColor3fromRGB`, `Color3Utils.deserializeFromColor3`, `Color3Utils.mutateRGB`, `Color3Utils.mutateHSV`, `Color3Utils.lighten`, `Color3Utils.darken`, `Color3Utils.getRelativeLuminance`.

LuvColor3Utils.luau.description: Converts and interpolates Color3 values in perceptual HSLuv space. Public entry points include `LuvColor3Utils.lerp`, `LuvColor3Utils.desaturate`, `LuvColor3Utils.darken`, `LuvColor3Utils.fromColor3`, `LuvColor3Utils.toColor3`.

LuvUtils.luau.description: Luv Utils provides the module implementation used by the Color3utils package. Public entry points include `distance_line_from_origin`, `length_of_ray_until_intersect`, `LuvUtils.get_bounds`, `LuvUtils.max_safe_chroma_for_l`, `LuvUtils.max_safe_chroma_for_lh`, `LuvUtils.dot_product`, `LuvUtils.from_linear`, `LuvUtils.to_linear`.
